claim: The uncorrected redundant field (case A) contains a large long-wavelength plane
numerical_evidence: E-W -11.719 mm/yr/km; N-S -2.881 mm/yr/km; magnitude 12.068; peak-to-peak 332.67 mm/yr; variance explained 64.39%
limitation: Describes the fitted plane only; does not establish whether it is deformation, orbit, atmosphere or unwrapping error

claim: Linear-ramp removal is the dominant processing sensitivity
numerical_evidence: B-A RMS 123.151 mm/yr; median shift -101.98 mm/yr; D-C RMS 122.350 mm/yr; chain-LR vs chain 122.654 mm/yr
limitation: Plane removal sets the gradient to zero by construction; the size of the change is not evidence that the gradient was an artifact

claim: Adding seven redundant interferograms barely changes the broad field
numerical_evidence: Chain vs redundant RMS 3.891 mm/yr on 80,787 px; E-W gradient change -0.012 mm/yr/km; detrended corr 0.9974
limitation: Differences concentrate at closure-failure pixels (21.09 vs 1.74 mm/yr RMS); stability under added edges does not validate the gradient

claim: Closure redundancy is sparse and local; failures concentrate mid-year
numerical_evidence: 2,334/81,299 px (2.871%) with nonzero ambiguity; triangle 0430-0512-0629 1.866%; 0629-0804-0816 0.955%; ambiguity up to +/-2 cycles; 7 triangles, cycle rank 7
limitation: Both original mid-year bridge edges belong to tested triangles in the expanded network; other links outside the triangles lack cycle checks; closure identifies an inconsistent triangle, not the faulty edge

claim: Excluding the two closure-flagged edges changes the map locally but not the gradient
numerical_evidence: RMS 3.688 mm/yr; extremes -103.62/+80.29 mm/yr; E-W -11.719 to -11.696 mm/yr/km
source_key: Velocity and correction sensitivity; row F_exclude_flagged_topo
limitation: Diagnostic stress test only; not an unwrapping correction

claim: Topographic-residual correction is a small effect
numerical_evidence: Chain: 0.975 mm/yr RMS; redundant: 0.971 mm/yr RMS; DEM-error/elevation r = 0.566
source_key: Materiality of corrections; Velocity and correction sensitivity
limitation: Single DEM-error model; does not address other elevation-correlated errors such as stratified troposphere

claim: ERA5 changes the field only slightly
numerical_evidence: C-A RMS 1.252 mm/yr; E-W gradient reduced 0.93%; spatial corr 0.999917; edge RMS 3.062 vs interior 0.846 mm/yr
limitation: Small ERA5 sensitivity does not rule out atmospheric error: coarse model, single nearest-hour (13:00 UTC) realization, no turbulent/urban structure

claim: Reference choice shifts the velocity datum but not spatial gradients
numerical_evidence: Datum shifts 204.73/207.53 mm/yr (redundant) and 204.73/206.51 (chain); E-W gradient identical to <2e-7 mm/yr/km
limitation: Reference changes neither validate nor invalidate spatial contrasts; no candidate patch has independent stability evidence

claim: Long-wavelength phase gradient is present in the two original mid-year chain bridge interferograms
numerical_evidence: 0.3477 and 0.3657 rad/km E-W; plane R2 0.632 and 0.697; max adjacent jumps 9.23 and 8.23 rad
limitation: Both edges are in tested expanded-network triangles; closure cannot identify a faulty edge or distinguish deformation from orbital or atmospheric error

claim: GNSS ICMX-MMX1 LOS differential
numerical_evidence: 256.3 mm/yr; OLS 95% 242.1-270.6; block bootstrap 246.5-264.5; Theil-Sen 255.0; exact-date only (6 epochs) 254.4; raw unfiltered 262.0
limitation: Two stations only; MMX1 covers 2024-04-16 to 2024-10-10 only; ICMX has an INEGI interference warning

claim: GNSS is consistent with no-ramp case A along the ICMX-MMX1 baseline
numerical_evidence: InSAR 240.5 mm/yr; GNSS-InSAR +15.8; U95 19.5; |d|/U95 0.81; aligned RMSE 3.5 mm
limitation: One mostly E-W baseline (10.72 km E, 2.80 km N); InSAR under-estimates by 6%; does not validate the full plane or the N-S gradient

claim: ERA5 no-ramp case C is borderline against GNSS
numerical_evidence: InSAR 234.3 mm/yr; GNSS-InSAR +22.0; U95 21.2; |d|/U95 1.04
limitation: Borderline under a study-defined envelope of selected terms; U95 does not bound all errors and ICMX interference is unquantified; no independent preregistration

claim: GNSS rejects linear-ramp removal along the ICMX-MMX1 baseline
limitation: Applies to this baseline only; about 73 mm of spurious GNSS drift in 168 d would be needed to reconcile

claim: GNSS comparison is robust to patch size, outliers and matching
numerical_evidence: Case A GNSS-InSAR 14.6/15.8/17.9 (5/9/13 px); exact-date +10.0; raw GNSS +21.5; leave-one-out 12.8-18.6; B/D stay 155-166
limitation: Largest systematic term is GNSS cadence (11.5 mm/yr: 244.9 daily vs 256.3 matched)

claim: Full-year InSAR differential is not equivalent to the GNSS window
numerical_evidence: Full-year ICMX-MMX1: A 227.7, B 94.2, C 227.3, D 94.9 mm/yr; common minus full A +12.8, B +3.9
limitation: Must not be compared directly with the 168-day GNSS rate; shown only to label the mismatch

claim: Fitted plane contributes about 134 mm/yr to the ICMX-MMX1 difference
numerical_evidence: A-B plane: E -11.72, N -2.88 mm/yr/km; baseline 10.72 km E, 2.80 km N; plane difference 133.7 mm/yr
limitation: Only the plane's projection onto one baseline is tested

claim: ICMX interference remains unquantified
numerical_evidence: ICMX annual LOS -14.9 to -43.4 mm/yr; 2024 vertical about double 2023; 2024 LOS scatter 4.2 mm; MMX1 annual LOS about -200 to -303 mm/yr (2008-2026)
limitation: Low scatter and annual histories cannot rule out smooth station bias; no numerical upper bound on interference is established

claim: Regional stations show no common mode comparable to the local contrast
numerical_evidence: MXTX -24.6, MXTO -45.0, TOL2 -16.3 mm/yr LOS; residual corr 0.17-0.46; frame leakage < 0.1 mm/yr
limitation: Outside the scene; frame/common-mode diagnostic only; not InSAR validation

claim: LOS sign and geometry verified from MintPy source
limitation: Descending only; LOS mixes east and up, so InSAR rates are not vertical subsidence

claim: Temporal coherence near 1 is not a quality proof
numerical_evidence: Chain: exactly 1.0 everywhere; redundant median 0.99978, p05 0.98453
limitation: Reflects low network redundancy rather than data accuracy

claim: ICMX and MMX1 sit inside the scene on a mostly east-west 11 km baseline, sampled by 9x9-pixel patches, separate from the northern-edge InSAR reference pixel
estimate_window: geometry (map shown is full-year 2024-01-13 to 2024-12-26; GNSS window 2024-04-18 to 2024-10-03)
numerical_evidence: ICMX 19.4056 N, -99.1709, pixel Y/X 130/41; MMX1 19.4317 N, -99.0684, pixel Y/X 95/175; station-coordinate baseline 11.1 km (10.76 E, 2.87 N); pixel-index baseline 10.72 E, 2.80 N; reference pixel Y/X 7/186; case-A 9x9 patch medians 181.49 / -46.24 mm/yr (full-year)
source_key: geometry.stations; geometry.pixel_rule; patches.A_redundant_no_ramp.*.9; ramp_plane.A_minus_B; script assertions
limitation: Location figure only; full-year map is not the GNSS-window rate; two points and one baseline; reference pixel stability unvalidated

claim: ERA5-corrected products carry a misleading configuration attribute but were ERA5-corrected
numerical_evidence: mintpy_redundant_era5/timeseries_demErr_ERA5.h5 attr mintpy.troposphericDelay.method = 'no'; logged tropo_pyaps3.py command; ERA5.h5 25/25 dates, 0 NaN; C-A RMS 1.252 mm/yr
limitation: Attribute is a load-time template copy, not processing history; protected HDF5 not edited; undocumented 3.2 mm check is not release evidence

claim: Two different median statistics describe the full-record B minus A map
numerical_evidence: median(pixelwise B-A) -101.984 mm/yr; median(B)-median(A) -137.430 mm/yr
limitation: Different operations; neither is the 168-day GNSS comparison
